name: Gallery of Treasures
summary: In the Scarlet Monastery, the Gallery of Treasures joins the Huntsman's Cloister to the Athenaeum. The Scarlet Crusade guards a corridor of Lordaeron's paintings, relics, and illuminated texts as it wages war against the undead.

sections.title: A Repository of Lost Heritage
sections.body:
Deep in the Library wing, the Gallery of Treasures runs from the Huntsman's Cloister kennels to the Athenaeum archives. Paintings and historical artifacts line the corridor. Small chambers hold books salvaged from across fallen Lordaeron.

The Scarlet Crusade calls these relics humanity's untainted legacy and has sworn to protect that heritage. Its zealots guard the passage against outsiders who enter their sanctuary.

faq.q: Where is the Gallery of Treasures located?
aliases: how to find gallery of treasures
faq.answer: The Gallery of Treasures lies inside the Library wing of the Scarlet Monastery. Just past the Huntsman's Cloister, the decorated passage leads to the Athenaeum.

faq.q: What is kept in the Gallery of Treasures?
aliases: what is in gallery of treasures
faq.answer: The Gallery holds preserved artwork, historical relics, illuminated texts, and paintings salvaged from ruined Lordaeron. They line the corridor and fill adjoining reading chambers.

faq.q: Why does the Scarlet Crusade collect these treasures?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade sees itself as Lordaeron's true remnant. It gathers cultural works to preserve its homeland's memory and sacred heritage while purging what it considers taint.

aliases: who is in gallery of treasures
faq.answer: Scarlet Crusade zealots patrol the corridor, including defenders and initiates. They guard the path toward Arcanist Doan and the monastery's deeper archives.

angles.text: As a paladin, you see artifacts and banners that recall the lost glory of the Silver Hand and fallen Lordaeron. Zealots hold them now, their righteous conviction turned to indiscriminate fanaticism.
As an undead, you see paintings and heirlooms that belonged to your Forsaken ancestors. Living crusaders guard them jealously as they seek to wipe out Lordaeron's former citizens.
